workflow: January recurring rent generation
exact_actions: Advance the simulation clock to 08:00 local; run or wait for scheduled finance worker; compare generated charges to active governing agreements, start dates, proration, and unique billing-period keys.

completion_gate: All expected records and amounts match; no unexplained error or stale state.
